questions.code:
d = {"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3}
d.pop("a")
d.popitem()
del d["b"]
print(len(d))
questions.explanation: pop removes 'a', popitem removes the last pair added ('c'), and del removes 'b' - nothing is left.
questions.hint: Remove one pair at a time and keep track of what remains. popitem takes the most recently added pair.
